integrity: The proof is elementary and symbolic; all eleven witnesses and all branch formulas were independently replayed by the packaged checker. Literature comparisons distinguish total multiplicity from distinct-prime support.
limitations: The theorem classifies only the range \(\Omega(n)\le4\); it makes no claim for higher total multiplicity. Finite enumeration is used only as regression evidence.
title: Near-perfect integers with \(\Omega(n)\le4\)
